title: Project metadata and management flags can retain withdrawn membership, ownership or login authority after asynchronous preparation

realPostgresHttp.result: Four real authenticated Gateway reads publish withdrawn private project metadata or stale management flags after committed membership, ownership and role changes during a preparation barrier.

borrowedAdapterComputer.result: Two HTTP adapter regressions show that retaining borrowed project views lets an in-place computer refresh pair prepared metadata with a different computer grant.

preparedMetadataComputer.result: Two HTTP adapter regressions show that current initial and final authority alone can publish older metadata from another known computer.

correction: Browser directory/detail reads perform one final control-database-only account, password, membership, project, mount, exact-computer and Steward admission after metadata preparation. Prepared computer identifiers are copied before authority waits. Current ownership, theme and management flags come from the final snapshot. Withdrawn entries are omitted and detail reads refuse publication. Missing adapters return501 and lookup failures return503 without prepared data or database diagnostics. Ordinary Runtime authority remains separate.
